using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const int mod = 1e9 + 7;

struct Matrix {
    vector<vector<int>> m;
    Matrix() : m(33, vector<int>(33, 0)) {}
    Matrix(int n) : m(n, vector<int>(n, 0)) {}
};

Matrix em, a[70], r, pre[70], suf[70];
ll N, K;

Matrix multiply(const Matrix& a, const Matrix& b) {
    int n = K + 1;
    Matrix c(n);
    for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                ll tmp = (ll)a.m[i][k] * b.m[k][j] % mod;
                c.m[i][j] = (c.m[i][j] + tmp) % mod;
            }
        }
    }
    return c;
}

void update() {
    int n = K;
    pre[0] = a[0];
    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i)
        pre[i] = multiply(pre[i - 1], a[i]);
    suf[n - 1] = a[n - 1];
    for (int i = n - 2; i >= 0; --i)
        suf[i] = multiply(a[i], suf[i + 1]);
    a[0] = suf[0];
    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i)
        a[i] = multiply(suf[i], pre[i - 1]);
}

void solve() {
    cin >> N >> K;
    int n = K;
    r = Matrix(n + 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        a[i] = Matrix(n + 1);
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
            a[i].m[j][j] = 1;
            a[i].m[j][i] = 1;
        }
        r.m[i][i] = 1;
    }
    r.m[n][n] = 1;
    while (N > 0) {
        int tt = N % K;
        if (tt) {
            ll pos = 0, tmp = N;
            while (tmp)
                pos = (pos + (tmp /= K)) % K;
            for (int i = tt - 1; i >= 0; --i)
                r = multiply(a[(pos + i) % K], r);
        }
        update();
        N /= K;
    }
    int ans = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        ans = (ans + r.m[n][i]) % mod;
    cout << ans << endl;
}

int main() {
    solve();
    return 0;
}
